{{Quote|I have prepared for this event and stored most of my personal belonging in my travel chest. Cobak will watch over it and keep them safe.|[[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Cobak's master]]|<ref name="SWG:TJGD" />}}
'''Cobak''' was a [[Xandank/Legends|xandank]] from the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. He belonged to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Jedi Knight]] that operated on Mustafar at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of [[Grey Squad]] to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the Jedi managed to survive the attack and temporarily escape from the clones. He stored all his personal belongings in a travel chest and hid it among ancient ruins in the [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] region. Then he ordered Cobak to guard the chest.

[[1 ABY/Legends|Twenty years later]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] found a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that contained the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight's]] last message and followed his instructions to the hidden travel chest. There he discovered that the loyal Cobak was still alive, closely guarding the chest and waiting for the return of his master. The xandank attacked ferociously, so the spacer had to [[Death/Legends|kill]] it. Written on the beast's collar, he found the code to open the chest.

==Behind the scenes==
Cobak was an enemy in the quest "The Jedi's Guard Dog" in ''Trials of Obi-Wan'', the third expansion of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' prior to the games closure on [[December 15]], 2011. After activating the Jedi's datapad, the player was led to the location of the travel chest. There, he would have to defeat Cobak in order to open the chest and get the contents.
